text:
Romi Alvarez: Quick QA pass on the routing policy editor during today's usability session. Two things stood out: insertion guide feels disconnected in narrow layouts, and the ‘invalid rule’ banner is not actionable.
Casey Nguyen: Noted. Narrow layout issue = insertion guide overlaps token counter and shifts when a sticky header collapses. We should decouple the guide from the token layer and optionally hide counters while dragging.
Ibrahim Khan: For the animation, recommend 'snap-to-visible-row' + 150ms ease instead of free-follow. Reduces teleport perception. Also compute final slot at drag-start to avoid index churn from virtualization.
Tess (a11y): Accessibility checklist: 1) keyboard move mode needs explicit entry/exit announcements, 2) live updates must be throttled, 3) validation banners should be role=status and include an action hint.
Tess (a11y): Suggested aria strings: on enter: "Move mode enabled. Use arrow keys to move, Enter to drop, Escape to cancel." On each settled move (throttle 200ms): "Moved to position {n} between '{prev}' and '{next}'".
Romi Alvarez: Love the action hint idea. For validation copy let's replace "Rule invalid" with: "Rule invalid: missing match clause. Press E to edit or click to open details." Make the "E" hotkey mention optional based on platform.
Casey Nguyen: Implementation notes: deep-linking to the failing field requires stable front-end ids. We'll add stableClientId to the draft model and use it for deep links and animation mapping (avoid DOM index reliance).
Ibrahim Khan: Virtual list tip: map visibleNodeIndex -> stableClientId at drag start and animate the ghost using that mapping. When nodes recycle, the mapping preserves the visual target.
Tess (a11y): For screen readers, prefer aria-live="polite" and role=status for the toast area. Avoid autofocus. Also ensure the focus remains on the source item while moving so keyboard users don't lose context.
Kai: Small UI tweak: show a compact ghost with left-aligned priority badge (fixed width) and a faint dashed insertion line. Use min-width on the badge to prevent list reflow. Color suggestion for badge text: #0B2545 on white for 14px bold to meet contrast.
Casey Nguyen: Perf: suspend sim recalculation while dragState=true, then run one update on drop. Add a 250ms debounce for non-drag changes. Also cancel inflight sim requests when new changes occur.
Romi Alvarez: UX for sim pane: show a subtle "Preview paused" ribbon in the header while dragging, and put a small spinner if the sim is stale. Don't let token counters overlay the insertion guide.
Tess (a11y): Reduced motion preference: respect prefers-reduced-motion and skip the easing; just place instantly. Also keep announcement timings reliable: announce after animation completes (or immediately if reduced-motion).
Kai: Toast layering: current toasts mount in global layer z=900, preview modal is z=1000. Portal to modal root and use role=status so they won't grab focus. Confirm with a quick keyboard test.
Ibrahim Khan: Dev checklist: - stableClientId on mount; - compute target slot at drag-start; - map animation targets by clientId; - suspend sim while dragging; - debounce sim 250ms; - portal toasts to modal root.
Casey Nguyen: Copy micro-nit: the insertion helper currently says "Drop to reorder" -> change to "Insert here to change priority" and in keyboard mode append "Press Enter to confirm".
design-bot: Reminder: design review Friday 11am PT. Agenda: ghost badge min-width, keyboard aria strings, toast portal behavior, sim debounce plan. Please attach short gifs/screenshots before 10am. :spiral_calendar:
